company.shortDescription: Encuadrado provides a platform for appointment scheduling, payments, and invoicing.
company.description: Encuadrado provides a platform for appointment scheduling, payments, and invoicing. The company was established in 2019 and is headquartered in Santiago, Chile.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that allows health professionals to manage their appointment calendars with features like opening/closing schedules, repeating sessions, rescheduling, blocking times, and setting daily session limits.
productsAndServices.name: Appointment Scheduling Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service that enables health professionals to receive advance or monthly payments online, with automatic reminders sent to patients for pending debts.
productsAndServices.name: Online Payment Processing

productsAndServices.description: A system that automatically generates electronic invoices for each payment, ensuring compliance with tax authorities without manual intervention.
productsAndServices.name: Automatic Electronic Invoicing (Boletas)

productsAndServices.description: A service that sends automatic appointment reminders and payment notifications to patients via WhatsApp and email.
productsAndServices.name: Patient Communication and Reminders

productsAndServices.description: A tool for managing patient records, including consultation notes and patient evaluations after sessions.
productsAndServices.name: Patient Records and Evaluations Management

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature that enables health professionals to create and sell courses, ebooks, or workshops to expand their service offerings beyond sessions.
productsAndServices.name: Sales and Content Delivery Platform (Vitrina)

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,500,000, or 92.31% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,268,806 to $9,704,735, a 4.28x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
